'''Harves-Nine''' was the codename assigned to the operation which included the [[Exogorth/Legends|exogorth]] control system test. Ordered by [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Arkoh Adasca]] during the [[Mandalorian Wars]], Harvest-Nine reawakened dormant exogorths and sent them to consume a small [[Planetoid/Legends|planetoid]] before returning to dormancy.
